manual_items_notes: Stations whose effect is not a timed buff, so neither keyword nor script discovery reaches them. Healing Arch (0089AD98): WorkshopDeconArchScript::DeconArchSpell = SCORE_S24_SPELL_HealingArch (RestoreHealthGeneric, magnitude 2, duration 1s) — instant heal on walking through, listed like the Blood Transfusion Pump.
vmad_discovery_notes: Script-cast buff discovery: an ACTI/FURN VMAD script property named in spell_props, or any property whose value is a SPEL whose EDID starts with one of spell_edid_prefixes, is resolved through the SPEL's timed 'Fortify <SPECIAL>' effects to page groups (no FormID table). Adds e.g. Mechanical Derby Game (OnActivateCastSpell::SpellToCast = ATX_BuffIntelligence), Fortune Teller Machine, West Virginia Slot Machine, Scent-o-matic, Body Scanner. Records still need an obtain route (COBJ, workshop build list, or ENTM).
interaction_notes: Per-station 'interaction' field. FURN -> animation (anim_keyword = first KWDA keyword matching anim_keyword_re); ACTI -> instant; ACTI carrying a walkthrough_keywords keyword -> walkthrough. machine_animates = the ACTI object itself animates (keyword or script listed above) while the player does not.
gold_how_notes: Healing Arch (0089AD98): hand-kept because src/gold_vendor.py joins ENTM -> plan through a *CondProxy*_GoldVendor COBJ + CNDF, and this plan is SCORE_S24_Recipe_HealingArch_StampVendor (COBJ SCORE_S24_co_HealingArch_StampVendor, no CondProxy/GoldVendor token). Samuel stocks it directly (LVLI 005A0AC3 entry 37, condition HasEntitlement(SCORE_S24_ENTM_CAMP_Utility_HealingArch)); BOOK price global Econ_GoldVendor_Tier_13 = 4000.
